opening: I'm feeling tired, with no energy.
I was in a car accident 3 months ago.
I wake up several times during the night.
I no longer want to do things for fun.
I feel sad all the time.
My girlfriend and my parents are very supportive. They know I've been having a hard time.

opening.text: I've been feeling really tired and low on energy for the past three months, which started around the time I was in a car accident. I wake up several times during the night and just feel sad all the time. I don't have any interest in doing things for fun anymore. I do drink beer and smoke cigarettes, but my girlfriend and parents are very supportive and know I've been having a hard time.
